text: もし　いきかえらせたら　ポケモンの　いちだい　はっけんだ！

structure.jp: もし　いきかえらせたら
structure.en: if one could bring it back to life

structure.jp: ポケモンの　いちだい　はっけんだ！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if that happens'; もし in front makes the 'if' clearer. もし　いきかえらせたら = 'if it could be brought back to life'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing いきかえる 'come back to life' to いきかえらせる means making something do that; the further change to いきかえらせたら here adds 'can' and 'if'. いきかえらせたら = 'if one could bring it back to life'.
